item.title: Chabad hosts youngest Holocaust twin studies survivor Sora Vigorito
item.description: Sunday, March 1, the College of William and Mary’s chapter of Chabad hosted Sora Vigorito, the youngest known survivor of Dr. Joseph Mengele’s twin studies during the Holocaust. Vigorito was one of 89 pairs of twins who underwent Mengele’s pseudoscientific studies at Auschwitz. Mengele, also known as the “Angel of Death,” was a German physician […]
